description: The shared Renovate preset for zgeoff Bun repos, which a repo takes with extends: github>zgeoff/tools. docs/architecture/dependency-updates.md describes each rule.

lockFileMaintenance.description: A lock-file refresh has no release timestamp, so the 7-day gate would hold it pending forever. bun install still applies the bunfig.toml release age to each version it resolves.

customManagers.description: Bun catalog entries, until renovatebot/renovate#42909 adds catalog support to the bun manager; remove this manager then.

packageRules.description: A catalog bump changes package.json only, so bun install refreshes bun.lock in the same commit. It needs self-hosted Renovate that allows the command.
Every update below major merges on green CI. Other minor bumps keep one PR per package.
Patch bumps go in one weekly PR.

TanStack router packages, React Start among them, ship together, so their patch and minor bumps stay in Renovate's monorepo group. The rule sits after the patch rule, which would otherwise take their patch bumps. The group opens at any time, as a minor bump does.
Dev-tool minor bumps go in one weekly PR. Their patch bumps go in the patch group.
Each major bump gets its own PR and waits for review. Majors open weekly, so they get reviewed in one sitting. The zgeoff, impz and sync-tag rules below override the schedule.
An override pins a transitive dependency, usually to a patched release, so a major bump would break the packages that depend on it.

zgeoff and impz packages bump at any level as soon as they publish, each in its own PR, and merge on green CI. bun install still needs the package in the repo's minimumReleaseAgeExcludes. A limit of 0 lets the branch open while the repo's other update branches fill the concurrent limit.

The zgeoff/tools workflow refs move to the newest sync tag as soon as it is cut, and merge on green CI. The tags are sync-v1, sync-v2 and so on, which are not semver. A limit of 0 lets the branch open while the repo's other update branches fill the concurrent limit.

Nothing merges by itself in nixie or noslop while their required pr / checks check skips on every pull request, because GitHub counts a skipped required check as passing. The rule sits last, so it overrides every automerge rule, lock-file maintenance included. A vulnerability fix keeps the automerge that vulnerabilityAlerts forces on it, so the pr-comment type turns that merge into a comment that no bot acts on. Remove this rule once sync-v24 is tagged, and nixie's and noslop's sync bumps to it have merged, with pr / checks running and gating on a pull request in each.
packageRules.automergeComment: Renovate does not merge this pull request: it waits for a review while this repo's pr / checks check skips.
